notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only sources are the Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia county list (position and status) and a general Virginia Department of Forestry history page, which does not name this tower. No builder, date, design, height, staffing, fire history or photo found in the local caches or two web searches; no registry number. Search results for the name returned only unrelated pages (a Cedar Run Estates map set, a county historical marker, a cemetery), none cited. Story is about 100 words, below the usual 120 because the evidence does not support more. Agency link for this tower is unverified.
